$comment: type:"dynamic" — this demo is a real WordPress + WooCommerce application in its own containers, not a static docroot. scripts/deploy.sh only handles type:"static" demos, so it neither rsyncs nor re-renders this vhost; the landing index and demos.json DO include it (they read every demo.json). `container` is a field this demo adds: the dynamic-demo run shape, so the box is reproducible from this file. `backend_port` is the WordPress container; `mcp_port` is this demo's OWN MCP server container (demo-woo-backend), which nginx routes /mcp to. `connector_id` is the tenant MCP connector this store's own /mcp is registered as — non-secret, and the value the box scopes its HS256 actor verifier to. See sites/woo/README.md.
